title: Apartamento T1 para venda

Discover this 1-bedroom apartment with 61 m² of private gross area, located on Rua do Agro, one of the most sought-after and well-serviced areas in Vila Nova de Gaia.

The excellent sun exposure guarantees natural light throughout the day, creating cozy and comfortable environments in every room. The kitchen is equipped with a hob, oven, and extractor fan, ready to use from day one.

The location is one of this property's major assets. It is just a few metres from the iconic Avenida da República, the heart of Gaia, with shops, restaurants, services, and all the vibrancy of city life right on your doorstep. The area offers a wide range of public transport options, providing fast connections to Porto and the entire metropolitan area.

It is ideal for first-time buyers, a young couple who values mobility, or investors looking for an asset with strong demand in the rental market.

A property with the right combination of comfort, light, and location. Book your visit today!

Idéal pour : ceux qui recherchent leur premier logement, un jeune couple qui apprécie la proximité du centre-ville, ou pour les investisseurs à la recherche d’un bien très rentable sur le marché locatif.

Profitez de cette opportunité d’allier confort, luminosité et emplacement idéal !
